units.source_text: 次日，源氏公子邸内召唤小君前去，小君即将动身，便向姐姐要封回信。

en.t: The next day, Prince Genji summoned Kokimi to his residence, and as Kokimi was about to set out, he asked his elder sister for a reply letter.

units.source_text: 空蝉说：“你回答他说：此间没有可拜读此信之人。”

en.t: Utsusemi said, "Answer him by saying, 'There is no one here who can read this letter with due respect.'"

units.source_text: 小君笑道：“他说并没弄错，怎么好对他如此说呢？”

en.t: Kokimi laughed and said, "He says he has made no mistake, so how could I say such a thing to him?"

units.source_text: 空蝉心中忧虑，想道：“可知他已经全部告诉这孩子了！”

en.t: Utsusemi grew anxious in her heart and thought, "So he has already told the child everything!"

units.source_text: 便觉无限痛苦，骂道：“小孩子家不应该说这种老头老脑的话！

en.t: She felt boundless distress and scolded him, saying, "A child should not speak in such old-fashioned, knowing words!
If that is how it is, then you must not go."

units.source_text: 小君说：“他召唤我，怎么好不去呢？”

en.t: Kokimi said, "He has summoned me, so how could I not go?"
